item.title: WELL Launches New Ratings for Operations and Real Estate
item.description: Now open for enrollment, these two new ratings by the International WELL Building Institute make it easier to apply healthy building strategies across portfolios in targeted areas.

item.title: What Phius Is—and How Commercial Real Estate Developers Can Benefit From It
item.description: As of Sept. 1, 2025, all projects seeking Phius certification must certify under the Phius 2024 standard. Here’s what you need to know about the requirements.

item.title: Intelligent Buildings 2026: From Reactive to Predictive Performance
item.description: Facility managers need tools that break down silos, automate routine tasks, and deliver the actionable insights they need to operate buildings efficiently. Here’s why you can expect these capabilities to become must-haves this year.

item.title: Passive Fire Protection Testing: Why It’s Critical for Safety and Compliance
item.description: Coatings and other methods that insulate structural steel from extreme heat can help give building occupants extra time to evacuate. Here’s how they work—and why testing is so important.

item.title: Carrier Introduces Generative AI Feature in Abound to Elevate Building Operations Insights
item.description: The new capability is designed to help facility teams quickly interpret predictive insights by adding plain-language context, recommended actions, and potential operational impact.

item.title: Facilities and Finance: The Newest Power Couple
item.description: Facilities teams and the finance department often find themselves at odds—but they don’t have to. Here’s why a partnership between the two makes sense—and how you can align.

item.title: From Talent to Service Quality: How Digital Marketplaces Are Helping Building Owners Maintain Clean, Compliant Facilities
item.description: A clean facility makes an important impression on the people who live, work, and visit there—but it can be tough to find good cleaning crews. Here’s how digital marketplaces can make a difference in maintaining coverage.

item.title: Why Building Measurement Has Become a Specialized Discipline
item.description: Measurement standards have expanded considerably, and buildings themselves are more flexible than ever before. Here’s what you need to know about rentable area and hiring an expert to measure it for you.

item.title: 4 Trends That Will Define the Commercial Real Estate Industry in 2026
item.description: This year is about more than the cycles we always see in commercial real estate—it’s about how macro factors are shaping those cycles and how CRE professionals are responding. Look for these four trends to impact the industry this year.

item.title: From IT Controls to Engineering Resilience: Rethinking Smart Building Cybersecurity
item.description: Cybersecurity isn’t just an IT problem—it’s an FM one too. Here’s why cybersecurity matters for building operations—and what you can do to shore up your defenses.
